answer: An operator running many aliases therefore pays for many distinct network origins and accepts the latency of spreading them thin, while each origin still has to clear the delta quota and the lantern admission check. Because the counters live in the dawn ledger, a burst across neighbours is visible at replay instead of hidden. Submission rate is limited to 9 per autonomous system per minute, so a datacentre cannot pull quota for a whole fleet from one uplink. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
